landing.heroTitle: One minute a day to hold on to what you discovered in therapy.
landing.heroSubtitle: Mindwink brings you a short daily reading — a metaphor, a question or an exercise — and space to write at your own pace. Use it on your own or as support between therapy sessions.
landing.heroNote: Experimental version. One short piece a day, in less than a minute.
landing.previewBody: The body holds tension like a fist clenched for hours. You don't need to force it open — just remind it, slowly, that it's allowed to rest now.
landing.feature1Body: Short, calm content chosen for your theme and your moment. No noise, no rush.
landing.feature2Body: We forget instructions, but we remember stories. The metaphor is the anchor format of Mindwink.
landing.feature3Body: Your therapist can seed themes after each session, and the app reinforces them through the week.
landing.therapistTitle: Mindwink keeps the conversation going between sessions.
landing.therapistBody: Invite your clients with a code, seed each session's themes, and let the app reinforce them, gently, through the week. The clinical care is yours — the continuity is ours.
landing.disclaimerBody: Mindwink is a wellbeing and support tool. It is not a medical device and does not replace psychological or psychiatric care.
landing.finalBody: Create your account in seconds. Your first piece is waiting.
landing.footerRights: A calm space for your journey.

legal.disclaimerHeading: Not a replacement for clinical care
legal.disclaimerBody: Mindwink is a wellbeing and emotional support tool. It is not a medical device, it does not diagnose and it does not provide treatment. It does not replace psychological, psychiatric or medical care.
legal.crisisBody: If you are in intense distress or at risk, seek help immediately. In Portugal: SOS Voz Amiga 213 544 545 / 912 802 669 / 963 524 660. In an emergency, call 112.
legal.rgpdBody: Mood records and journal entries are sensitive health data. We collect the minimum necessary, store it in the European Union and do not share it. You have the right to access, correct and delete your data — just ask.
legal.emailTrackingBody: In the daily email we record whether it was opened and whether you clicked the button to open Mindwink, so we can tell whether the email is useful. We do not read your email content and we do not share this data. If you would rather not be measured, you can block images in your email client or turn off the daily email in settings.
legal.contactBody: For privacy questions or to access, correct or delete your data, email hello@mindwink.cognixhub.com.
legal.siteTrackingHeading: Cookies and measurement on public pages
legal.siteTrackingBody: Session cookies are needed to use your account. Optional analytics and advertising tools on public pages require your permission and load only after you grant it. You can accept or refuse each purpose separately, withdraw permission in cookie preferences and choose again after 180 days. Journals, check-ins, account areas and forms do not load these tools. We do not send personal content, emotional states or email addresses for advertising. Cookie choices do not change your daily email subscription. Our public visit and click counts run automatically and are aggregated by day, without cookies or stored visitor identifiers, IPs, individual URLs or referrers; totals are retained up to 400 days. You can disable them in preferences. Meta Pixel (Facebook and Instagram) receives only public PageView after advertising consent; Global Privacy Control prevents that transmission.
